rows.title: Zero original movement
rows.requirement: compare original DOM order and computed box geometry of every original UI element. Original 13 Layers groups, 63 proxies, menu headings and map controls retain order/position at each viewport in each opened state.

rows.title: Exact delta
rows.requirement: candidate sld-sandbox file equals original *bytes* plus newline plus module bytes; no CRLF mutation; proof and composition hashes agree.

rows.title: Four-slot discipline
rows.requirement: no extra composer slot or replaced bridge; correct immutable shell, original MapLibre version and original CSS.

rows.title: Control inventory
rows.requirement: menuBar.inspect() exact baseline object {engineInputs:60, pnInputs:3, total:63, proxies:63, installed:true} or corresponding original array representation, plus precisely 63 private markers. Do not count unrelated basemap radios as core layers. Check while OFF and ON.

rows.title: Event semantics
rows.requirement: original six-menu dropdown opens/closes, body click works, Grid ArrowDown starts at engine:400, native Layers/SCADA opens, curtain works, search focus intact, no event capture swallowing original controls.

rows.title: Keyboard
rows.requirement: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Arrow keys, Escape, focus restoration. Lightning keyboard interactions meaningful with correct role/checked/aria semantics.

rows.title: Touch
rows.requirement: actual hit-tested clicks/taps, no force:true, no JS direct invocation replacing user gestures; 44x44px targets where justified on mobile.

rows.title: Preserve layering
rows.requirement: no new map-layer/source while OFF; map after OFF exactly returns to original state, and all existing grid layers remain clickable.

rows.title: Layout
rows.requirement: compare original vs candidate at rest, Grid dropdown, native Layers open, fullscreen curtain open, About open and deep-link arrival. Include 1440x900, 393x852, 360x740, 390x844 iPhone-like geometry; 1280x720 + 1920x1080 supplemental for clipping diagnosis. Chromium emulation is NOT real iPhone Safar

rows.title: Pixel evidence
rows.requirement: paired same-harness screenshots and masked diff; mask only non-deterministic live clock/DAYS, canvas tiles/particles and lightening-owned additive group. No blanket masking of the menu/panel.

rows.title: No mutation storm
rows.requirement: idle 30 s ON, monitor lightning-owned DOM updates/body observer, cap <20 lightning-caused mutations; no blinking/ticking write loop.

rows.title: No unintended data traffic
rows.requirement: idle OFF triggers 0 lightning requests, 0 sources and no 10-minute updater; while ON only declared data endpoints.

rows.title: Controls accessible
rows.requirement: all original controls and *approved* new Lightning control physically reachable in normal viewport without programmatic scrolling to clipped content. Any known original clipping must be honestly separated from new regression.

rows.title: Accessibility
rows.requirement: named/announced toggle, state and labels, focus/touch, readable contrast, reduced-motion tolerance; no seizure-like animation, flashing UI or forced sound.

rows.title: Resource budget
rows.requirement: overlay 23,973 bytes originally; sld-sandbox <460,000 bytes and proof budgets pass; measured CPU/memory/network and first interaction budget; do not blindly introduce new CDN/browser library.

rows.title: What is observed
rows.requirement: EUMETSAT MTG LI L2-LFL optical flash centroids/time, not ground strike channels; always display exact wording and attribution, including popup where present.

rows.title: Geodesy
rows.requirement: lon/lat valid and within declared UK+neighbour-waters bounds (-11,49.5) to (3,61.5); validate and quarantine malformed/out-of-box records; no invented bolt paths or attribution to individual pylons.

rows.title: Time semantics
rows.requirement: timestamps UTC, selection [start,end) consistently, true selected start/end, actual first/last observations INSIDE selection, ingestion/generated timestamp kept separate from last detection timestamp.

rows.title: Current windows
rows.requirement: 12h,24h,48h,7d from available underlying observations; no saying 408 'in last hour' if actual feed spans five days.

rows.title: History windows
rows.requirement: 30d,3m,6m,12m and custom, clamped to retention boundary; PREV/NEXT/LATEST exact and justified; no invented historical coverage prior to collector start.

rows.title: Archive absent
rows.requirement: index 404/schema mismatch/CORS/network issue → explicit fallback to rolling seven-day feed, with 'archive not published/unavailable', and long ranges disabled, never zero.

rows.title: Missing=unknown
rows.requirement: missing days, scan gaps, failed runs, partial coverage, not-yet-ingested tail all explicitly unknown; zero only if searched coverage and count legitimately zero.

rows.title: Schema
rows.requirement: index v2, dated shards v1, day parts[] for high-volume split dates, sha256/bytes/count metadata consistency, sealed/unsealed cache correctness. Candidate rejecting v1 is a KNOWN DEVIATION — adjudicate its impact with PR #2, do not silently normalise the scope.

rows.title: Time-window correctness
rows.requirement: DST boundary, UTC midnight, leap day, month-length variation, leap-year 12-month lookback, date picker From > To, date before archive, future date, mid-window ingestion and selected window outside feed retention.

rows.title: Concurrency
rows.requirement: four shard reads max, settled per shard with named failures; LRU 8; cancellation and stale responses may NOT repaint a newer window or leave old points under a mismatching caption.

rows.title: Budget tier
rows.requirement: detail up to 31 days only if <=40k index count and <=32MB; larger index summary before fetch. >31d daily index only by default; LOAD POINTS explicit and honest; 10k phone/40k desktop map cap and cluster state honestly indicated.

rows.title: Large storm
rows.requirement: max shard 25MB, target 8MiB and parts[] hourly split; 100k-flash day stress. Zero synthetic observation points in published archive; synthetic counts are allowed in TEST FIXTURES only, clearly labelled.

rows.title: Status captions
rows.requirement: show selection window, first/last genuine detection, archived vs drawn counts, refreshed/published timestamp with stale semantics, coverage fraction/runs, warnings + UTC/source/uncertainty note; if footer/legend hidden, fail visibility.

rows.title: State matrix
rows.requirement: OFF, LOADING, READY·DETAIL, READY·SUMMARY, EMPTY-COVERED, PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, BEFORE-ARCHIVE, FAIL and STALE modifier. Distinguish network error from successfully searched and empty.

rows.title: Failure handling
rows.requirement: bad JSON, HTTP 404/500, partial shard failure, stale index, sha mismatch, CORS/network rejection, zero feed, cancelled request, stop/start rapidly. Newest partial features remain accurately labelled if FAIL. Candidate keeping toggle ON on FAIL is a KNOWN DEVIATION vs original V10 — reviewer must rul

rows.title: Transport
rows.requirement: .json absolute fetch bypasses original broad .geojson interceptor; rolling feed .geojson uses tested XHR; verify intercepted_on_demand unchanged, request headers/CORS/cache must be tested *live* separately. No original bridge edits.

rows.title: Collector
rows.requirement: hourly at minute 17; max(6h, gap+30m) lookback capped 48h, successful examined 10-minute slots only, missed source product coverage recorded unknown; status always writes heartbeat, feed-first/archive-second; backfill not fabricated.

rows.title: Retention/provenance
rows.requirement: true prospective rolling UTC year; initial genuine 408 events seed with partially searched days. EUMETSAT availability and licensing/attribution checked. Actual archive is NOT presently live merely because draft PR #2 exists.
